description: You are a licensed land surveyor preparing a boundary survey drawing for a residential property sale. The building footprint is shown in the floor plan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf'. Your task is to overlay a complete boundary survey on this floor plan, adding all elements required for a legal boundary survey drawing. The overlay must include: (1) lot property boundary lines forming a closed polygon around the building with appropriate setbacks, labeled with bearings in standard surveying notation (e.g., 'N 45°30 E' or 'S 89°15 W') and distances, (2) front, rear, and side yard setbacks appropriate for R-1 residential zoning (20 ft front setback, 5 ft side setbacks, 20 ft rear setback are typical — scale and adjust to the drawing units), (3) at least one utility easement marked with dashed lines and appropriate easement annotation, (4) a survey legend or notes block identifying the symbols and conventions used, (5) a north arrow indicator with 'N' directional text. All survey elements must be organized on dedicated layers following professional survey drafting conventions. Save the completed drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_survey.dxf'.
